name: Firefox
description: Fast, private, and self-hosted secure browser for browsing without limits.
composeYaml:
services:
  firefox:
    image: jlesage/firefox:latest
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'firefox_config:/config'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:5800/'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
